# Policy matrix

Every consequential write is an ActionRequest evaluated by the deterministic policy engine (`fg-policy-1.1.0`) at proposal and again at preflight. Outcomes: ALLOW (pre-authorized), REQUIRE_APPROVAL (one approval per required group, distinct people, never the proposer, MFA, bound to the action hash), or DENY. No action is successful until VERIFIED by independent read-back.

## Default approver roles

| Risk category | Default approver roles (when the tenant has not configured the category) |
| --- | --- |
| SPEND | finance_approver, owner |
| PRICING | finance_approver, owner |
| PUBLIC_PUBLISHING | approver, admin, owner |
| MESSAGING | approver, admin, owner |
| TARGETING | approver, privacy_officer, owner |
| DATA_EXPORT | privacy_officer, owner |
| SYNTHETIC_PERSONA | approver, legal_approver, owner |
| EXPERIMENT | approver, admin, owner |
| STORE_METADATA | approver, admin, owner |
| PAYOUT | finance_approver, owner |
| INTERNAL | admin, owner |

A legal group (`legal_approver` or `owner`) is added by R-JURISDICTION and R-CLAIMS when needed.

## Rules

| Rule | What it enforces |
| --- | --- |
| R-ALLOWLIST | Action type must be on the deny-by-default allowlist and supported; unsupported types (SMS, WhatsApp, payouts) are denied with their blocker reference. |
| R-KILL | No engaged kill switch in scope (system, tenant, connector, object, model, agent). Re-checked immediately before the provider call. |
| R-CAPABILITY | Capability exists in the registry with the configured API version; app-review requirements are met; the configured provider API version has not reached its sunset (FG-P2-001). |
| R-CONNECTION | Connection is active, healthy enough, and holds every required scope. |
| R-EVIDENCE | Agent/system proposals need admitted, current evidence permitted for autonomous execution (D-023); human proposals without evidence need approval. |
| R-CHILDREN / R-SENSITIVE | Children's data and sensitive or proxy attributes never drive targeting or messaging (BLOCK). |
| R-JURISDICTION | Public, messaging, spend, pricing and export actions need target geographies with a legal-approved rule pack; otherwise a legal approval group is added. |
| R-CLAIMS | Cited claims exist, are approved and unexpired; regulated claims add legal approval. |
| R-ENDORSEMENT / R-PERSONA | Material connections and synthetic personas require disclosure text; personas must be approved and not suspended. |
| R-ASSETS | Referenced assets exist and are publish-eligible (rights manifest + QA). |
| R-MESSAGING | Recipient not suppressed; commercial mail needs current consent, a complete sender identity (CAN-SPAM), configured frequency caps; quiet hours defer execution. |
| R-PLATFORM | Platform-specific rules, e.g. TikTok unaudited apps may only post SELF_ONLY; YouTube synthetic media must be flagged. |
| R-EXPERIMENT | Experiment exists and is startable; high-risk experiments always require human approval. |
| R-AUTONOMY / R-SPEND / R-AUDIENCE | Tenant category policy: deny, approval_required, or pre-authorized within per-action/24 h spend ceilings and audience-size limits. Unconfigured categories always require approval. |
